about: SpellDirector sound cue library. A template's sound_cue layer names one of these cues; the viewer plays it in sync with the layer's beats. Every cue has a procedural Web Audio placeholder (web/js/audio.js, recipe = the cue id). To use real recordings, list files under 'samples' (paths relative to web/sounds/) and credit each one in web/sounds/CREDITS.md. 'character' describes the sound (texture, pitch, envelope, the layers it is built from, tail, space); 'sfx_prompt' is a ready prompt for a text-to-sound-effects generator; 'synth' is a procedural recipe; 'search' are sound-library search terms; 'flavors' adds per-element words to the prompts. See docs/sound-design.md and web/sounds/README.md.

psychic.words: warped, pulsing, otherworldly, pressure in the ears

charge.label: Energy charge
charge.describes: A rising swell of energy that builds in pitch and volume, then cuts off.

character.texture: smooth tone with a rising airy hiss on top
character.pitch: low to high: about two octaves up over the length
character.envelope: swells from silence, loudest just before the end, then a hard cut (no fade)
layers: tone: a filtered saw or synth pad gliding upward
air: noise through a band-pass that opens and rises with the tone
sweetener: a faint tremolo that speeds up toward the end
character.tail: none: it cuts off the instant the release starts
character.space: close and fairly dry; the game adds its own reverb

charge.sfx_prompt: magical energy charging up, smooth rising pitch swell with an airy hiss, tension building, ends with an abrupt cutoff, no impact, no music
charge.synth: Saw oscillator gliding exponentially 110 to 440 Hz through a low-pass sweeping 300 to 3000 Hz, plus white noise through a band-pass rising 800 to 5000 Hz. Exponential gain swell to the last 5%, then cut to zero in 10 ms.

hum.label: Low hum
hum.describes: A steady, low, smooth hum, like a powered beam or a held aura.

character.envelope: fades in over about 80 ms, holds, fades out over about 150 ms
layers: body: two detuned low saws a few cents apart (slow beating)
warmth: a sine an octave up
motion: slow 4-6 Hz tremolo

hum.sfx_prompt: steady low energy hum, warm smooth drone with slow beating, constant pitch, seamless loop, no music
hum.synth: Two saws at 55 and 55.6 Hz plus a 110 Hz sine, low-passed at about 400 Hz, with a 6 Hz tremolo of 25% depth.

buzz.label: Electric buzz
buzz.describes: A harsh, gritty electrical buzz, like a live wire or a transformer.

character.texture: gritty, harsh, electrical, with irregular flutter
character.envelope: fast in (20 ms), holds, quick out
layers: body: harmonically rich tone at a mains frequency, band-passed around 1-2 kHz
grit: slight distortion
flutter: irregular amplitude jitter (arcing)

buzz.sfx_prompt: harsh electrical buzz, live high-voltage wire arcing, gritty transformer hum with irregular flutter, loop, no music
buzz.synth: Square at 100 Hz and saw at 150 Hz through a band-pass at 1.3 kHz (Q 1.2), soft-clipped, amplitude jittered by a random 20-40 Hz flutter.

crackle.label: Electric crackle
crackle.describes: Random small electric pops and snaps, like static discharge.

character.texture: dry, sparse, sharp clicks and pops
character.pitch: high (2-10 kHz), each pop slightly different
character.envelope: a random scatter of 1-10 ms clicks, about 20-40 per second
layers: pops: very short bursts of high-passed noise at random times
variety: random loudness and length per pop

crackle.sfx_prompt: random electric static crackle, small sharp snaps and pops, sparse and dry, irregular rhythm, no hum, no music
crackle.synth: High-passed white noise (2 kHz) gated by random clicks: about 38 per second, each a 3-12 ms exponential decay at random loudness.

sizzle.label: Sizzle
sizzle.describes: A bright fluttering hiss, like current running through the air or meat on a grill.

character.texture: bright airy hiss with a fast flutter
character.envelope: fades in over 30 ms, holds, fades out over about 120 ms
layers: hiss: high-passed noise
flutter: 12-20 Hz amplitude wobble
sweetener: a few tiny pops

sizzle.sfx_prompt: bright sizzling hiss, fluttering high-frequency fizz like water on a hot pan or current through air, no music
sizzle.synth: White noise high-passed at 4.5 kHz with a 17 Hz amplitude flutter (40% depth) and a handful of random clicks.

zap.label: Zap
zap.describes: A short electric zap that sweeps down in pitch.

character.pitch: starts high (about 2 kHz) and drops fast
character.envelope: instant attack, about 100-200 ms decay
layers: tone: a saw sweeping steeply down
click: a 10 ms noise burst on the attack

zap.sfx_prompt: short electric zap, sharp spark with a quick downward pitch sweep, buzzy, under a quarter second, no music
zap.synth: Saw sweeping exponentially 1800 to 140 Hz over the length, low-passed at 5 kHz, gain decaying fast; plus a 10 ms high-passed noise click on the attack.

crack.label: Sharp crack
crack.describes: A sharp, bright snap with a short ring-out, like a thunder crack or a whip.

character.pitch: full range: a bright snap on top of a low thump
character.envelope: instant attack, a 20-40 ms crackling rip, then a ring-out of about 300 ms
layers: transient: a very short full-band noise snap
rip: a rapid burst of 5-15 crackles over 30 ms (the tearing air)
body: low thump dropping 140 to 60 Hz
ring: band-passed noise around 2-3 kHz decaying
character.tail: short ring-out; pair with rumble for the long thunder tail

crack.sfx_prompt: sharp close thunder crack, explosive bright snap with a ripping crackle and a short ring-out, very fast attack, no rolling thunder, no music
crack.synth: Full-band noise hit decaying in 40 ms, a fast burst of 10 random clicks across the first 30 ms, a sine thump 140 to 60 Hz, and band-passed noise at 2.4 kHz decaying over a quarter of the length. Light saturation.

boom.label: Deep boom
boom.describes: A deep, heavy boom that drops in pitch, like an explosion or a big hit.

character.pitch: sub and low (30-120 Hz), pitch falling
character.envelope: instant attack, long decay of 0.5-1.5 s
layers: transient: a short noise punch
sub: a sine dropping from about 110 to 30 Hz
body: low-passed noise that darkens as it decays
weight: gentle saturation so it reads on small speakers
character.tail: long, dark; let the reverb carry it

boom.sfx_prompt: deep cinematic boom, heavy low-end explosion impact with a sub drop and a dark decaying tail, no debris, no music
boom.synth: Sine sweeping 110 to 32 Hz over 60% of the length, plus low-passed noise (500 down to 90 Hz) with a fast hit envelope; soft-clip the sum.

rumble.label: Low rumble
rumble.describes: A low rolling rumble that wobbles, like distant thunder or a quake.

character.envelope: fades in over about 200 ms, holds with slow random swells, long fade out
layers: body: brown noise low-passed around 130 Hz
motion: slow random loudness wobble (rolling)
sub: a quiet 35-40 Hz sine

rumble.sfx_prompt: low rolling rumble, distant thunder or quake, slow wobbling swells, dark and heavy, long fade, no crack, no music
rumble.synth: Brown noise low-passed at 130 Hz with a slow random gain wander (0.35-1, every 120 ms), plus a quiet 38 Hz sine.

impact.label: Thud
impact.describes: A short, punchy body hit or thud with a click on top.

character.pitch: low-mid (60-250 Hz) with a click on top
character.envelope: instant attack, 100-300 ms decay
layers: click: a short low-passed noise tick
body: a sine thump dropping 170 to 50 Hz

impact.sfx_prompt: short punchy impact thud, solid body hit with a tight click, quick decay, no reverb tail, no music
impact.synth: Sine thump sweeping 170 to 50 Hz over 120 ms with a fast exponential decay, plus a 10 ms low-passed noise click.

crash.label: Crash
crash.describes: A noisy crash with debris scattering after it, like rocks or a wall breaking.

character.envelope: instant attack, a noisy burst, then debris that thins out over 0.5-1 s
layers: transient: band-passed noise burst
body: low thump
debris: random small hits that get quieter and sparser

crash.sfx_prompt: heavy crash with scattering debris, rocks and rubble breaking and tumbling, settles after a second, no music
crash.synth: Band-passed noise hit (1.4 kHz, Q 0.6), a sine thump 120 to 45 Hz, and band-passed noise gated by about 30 random pops per second that fade out.

shatter.label: Shatter
shatter.describes: Bright glassy pings and tinkles, like glass or ice breaking.

character.envelope: an instant crunch, then pings that thin out over 0.5-1 s
layers: crunch: high-passed noise burst
shards: 15-25 short sine pings at random high pitches, clustered early

shatter.sfx_prompt: glass or ice shattering, bright crunchy break followed by tinkling shards falling and settling, no music
shatter.synth: High-passed noise (5.5 kHz) burst plus about 18 sine pings at random 2-6.5 kHz, each 40-140 ms, clustered toward the start.

ignite.label: Ignite
ignite.describes: A soft fwoomp as something bursts into flame.

character.envelope: a 50-150 ms swell into a soft peak, then a 300-600 ms decay
layers: body: low-passed noise whose filter opens fast then closes
thump: a soft low sine
sweetener: a few crackles at the end

ignite.sfx_prompt: fire ignition, soft breathy fwoomp as flames burst up, warm whoosh, quick swell then settle, no explosion, no music
ignite.synth: Noise through a low-pass that opens 200 to 2600 Hz in 120 ms then closes to 350 Hz; gain swells in 120 ms then decays; plus a soft 80 to 45 Hz sine thump.

fire.label: Burning fire
fire.describes: A roaring, crackling fire, like a torch or a burning area.

character.envelope: fades in over about 150 ms, holds with random swells, fades out
layers: roar: low-passed brown noise with slow random swells
crackle: random pops of high-passed noise (embers)
air: a faint high hiss

fire.sfx_prompt: roaring fire with crackling embers, steady burning flames, breathy low roar, seamless loop, no music
fire.synth: Brown noise low-passed at 700 Hz with slow gain wander (0.3-0.6) plus high-passed noise gated by about 14 random pops per second.

whoosh.label: Whoosh
whoosh.describes: Air rushing past, like a fast swing or a projectile flying by.

character.pitch: sweeps up then down (300 Hz to 2 kHz to 500 Hz)
character.envelope: swells to a peak at about 40-50% of its length, then falls; the peak is the moment it passes
layers: air: noise through a band-pass sweeping up then down
optional: a faint pitched tone following the sweep for magical whooshes
character.space: close; pan it with the motion if you can

whoosh.sfx_prompt: fast air whoosh passing by, clean swoosh rising to a peak then falling away, no impact, no music
whoosh.synth: Noise through a band-pass (Q 1.8) sweeping 300 to 2200 Hz over 45% of the length and back to 500 Hz; exponential gain up to the same peak and down.

wind.label: Wind
wind.describes: A breathy gust of wind that rises and falls.

character.envelope: fades in over about 350 ms, rises and falls in slow gusts, fades out
layers: air: noise through a resonant band-pass whose center wanders (the howl)
gusts: slow random loudness swells
body: quiet low-passed noise underneath

wind.sfx_prompt: howling wind gust rising and falling, airy breathy storm wind, slow swells, no rain, no music
wind.synth: Pink noise through a band-pass (Q 3.5) whose center wanders between 380 and 1100 Hz every 250 ms, with a slow random gain wander.

shimmer.label: Shimmer
shimmer.describes: Twinkling high chimes, like sparkles, healing or a magic glow.

character.pitch: high (1-3 kHz notes), from a pentatonic scale so it never clashes
character.envelope: a scatter of soft bell pings across the length, each with a long gentle tail
layers: notes: sine or bell pings from a pentatonic scale at random times
air: a quiet high hiss

shimmer.sfx_prompt: magical shimmer, soft twinkling bell chimes and sparkles, gentle and airy, no melody, no music
shimmer.synth: About 14 pings per second, each a sine at a random note of a C pentatonic scale between 1 and 2.6 kHz with a 150 ms decay, plus very quiet high-passed noise.

splash.label: Splash
splash.describes: A wet slap of water hitting something, with droplets spattering down after.

character.envelope: instant slap, a short burst of spray, then droplets pattering for 0.3-0.6 s
layers: slap: a short band-passed noise hit with a low thump
spray: high-passed noise that decays
droplets: many tiny bloops (fast upward pitch chirps) at random times

splash.sfx_prompt: big water splash, wet slap with spray, then droplets pattering down, no music
splash.synth: Band-passed noise hit (900 Hz) with a 120 to 60 Hz thump; high-passed noise decaying over 300 ms; 20-30 tiny sine chirps rising 600 to 1600 Hz in 20 ms each, scattered over the length.

stream.label: Water rush
stream.describes: A rushing, gurgling torrent of water, like a fire hose or a river in flood.

character.envelope: fades in over about 100 ms, holds with churning swells, fades out
layers: rush: pink noise through a wide band-pass with random swells
bubbles: random small bloops
low churn: low-passed noise underneath

stream.sfx_prompt: rushing water torrent, high-pressure water jet gushing and churning, wet and bubbly, seamless loop, no music
stream.synth: Pink noise band-passed around 1.2 kHz (Q 0.7) with slow random gain wander, low-passed noise at 300 Hz below it, and 15-25 random bubble chirps per second.

freeze.label: Freeze
freeze.describes: Ice forming and creaking: crisp crackles over a cold glassy whistle.

character.pitch: high crackles over a thin high whistle
character.envelope: builds over the length as the ice spreads, then stops
layers: crackle: dense high clicks, like ice cubes cracking in a drink
creak: a few slow low groans (stressed ice)
air: a cold thin whistle or high hiss

freeze.sfx_prompt: ice freezing and crystallizing, crisp crackling and creaking ice spreading, cold glassy whistle, no music
freeze.synth: High-passed noise gated by clicks whose rate rises from 10 to 60 per second, a thin band-passed noise whistle at 6 kHz, and two or three slow saw groans at 150-250 Hz through a narrow band-pass.

squelch.label: Squelch
squelch.describes: A thick, wet, sticky squelch, like stepping in mud or something visceral tearing.

character.pitch: low-mid, with a short upward squish
character.envelope: a soft attack (10-20 ms), a gloopy middle, quick decay
layers: body: low-passed noise with a resonant filter sweeping up (the suck)
wet: a few low bloops
stick: a short high crackle at the end

squelch.sfx_prompt: thick wet squelch, sticky visceral flesh sound, gloopy and organic, short, no screams, no music
squelch.synth: Noise through a resonant band-pass (Q 6) sweeping 250 to 900 Hz and back, gain swelling in 20 ms and decaying; plus 3-5 low sine bloops (150 to 300 Hz chirps) and a few soft clicks at the end.

heartbeat.label: Heartbeat
heartbeat.describes: A low double thump (lub-dub) pulsing steadily, felt more than heard.

character.envelope: a lub-dub pair (the second softer, about 150 ms after the first) about 70-100 times a minute
layers: thump: a short sine thump dropping 80 to 40 Hz
muffle: a little low-passed noise on each beat

heartbeat.sfx_prompt: slow deep heartbeat, muffled low lub-dub pulse, steady rhythm, felt more than heard, no music
heartbeat.synth: Each beat: a sine thump 80 to 40 Hz decaying in 120 ms with a quiet low-passed noise tick, then a softer one 150 ms later; repeat every 700 ms.

whisper.label: Whispers
whisper.describes: Breathy, unintelligible whispering voices drifting around, eerie and close.

character.envelope: fades in slowly, drifts with random swells, fades out
layers: breath: noise through two or three band-passes at vowel formant frequencies that drift
sibilance: occasional short high 'ss' bursts
movement: slow random pan
character.space: close, intimate, a touch of reverb

whisper.sfx_prompt: eerie whispering voices, breathy unintelligible whispers drifting around, dark and intimate, no words, no music
whisper.synth: Pink noise through three band-passes (Q 8) at formant pairs that hop between vowels (for example 500/1500/2500 and 700/1100/2600 Hz) every 150-300 ms, gated by slow random syllable-like swells, with short 6-8 kHz 'ss' bursts.

drain.label: Life drain
drain.describes: A reversed, sucking inhale that pulls toward the caster, like life being drawn out.

character.pitch: low to mid, rising as it pulls in
character.envelope: reverse-shaped: starts quiet and swells, peaks at the end, then cuts
layers: suck: noise through a band-pass sweeping upward (a reversed whoosh)
body: a low detuned tone rising slowly
texture: faint wet gurgles
character.tail: none; it cuts when the drain ends

drain.sfx_prompt: dark magic life drain, hollow reversed sucking inhale pulling inward, swelling then cutting off, eerie, no music
drain.synth: Pink noise through a band-pass (Q 3) sweeping 200 to 1800 Hz with gain swelling exponentially to the end and cut in 15 ms; two detuned saws gliding 70 to 110 Hz low-passed at 500 Hz; a few low bubble chirps.

drone.label: Dark drone
drone.describes: An ominous, dissonant low drone with slow beating, like a curse settling in.

character.pitch: low (40-200 Hz) with a dissonant interval (a tritone or minor second)
character.envelope: slow fade in (300 ms or more), holds, slow fade out
layers: root: a low saw or organ-like tone
dissonance: a second tone a tritone or minor second away so it beats
air: a dark breathy noise bed
motion: a slow filter sweep
character.space: big and dark; more reverb than most cues

drone.sfx_prompt: ominous dark drone, low dissonant tones slowly beating, hollow and menacing, slow swell, no melody, no music
drone.synth: Saws at 55, 55.4 and 77.8 Hz (a tritone up) through a low-pass that slowly wanders 200-700 Hz, plus quiet low-passed pink noise; long attack and release.
